verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.requesty.ai that returns HTTP 200 and describes the product. Doc pages are also served as raw markdown (e.g. quickstart.md), and each points agents to the llms.txt documentation index, so an agent can be aimed straight at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and no first-party page explaining or promoting llms.txt use.
